questions.prompt: Which two explorers led the famous Corps of Discovery expedition?
questions.fact: The expedition depended on Sacagawea, whose presence with an infant signalled to the nations they met that this was not a war party.

questions.prompt: What type of eclipse happens when the Moon blocks the Sun from view?
questions.fact: Total solar eclipses only work because the Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon and also about 400 times further away.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses pins, lanes, and a heavy ball?
questions.fact: A perfect game is 300 — twelve strikes in a row, because the tenth frame grants two extra deliveries.

questions.prompt: Which movie features a museum night guard named Larry Daley?
questions.fact: It is set in New York's American Museum of Natural History, though most of the interiors were built as sets.

questions.prompt: Which African country has Addis Ababa as its capital?
questions.fact: Ethiopia was never colonised, and keeps its own calendar, which runs about seven years behind the Gregorian one.

questions.prompt: What are the names of the two dogs in 'Where the Red Fern Grows'?
questions.fact: The dogs hunt as a pair, and the book's title comes from a legend that a red fern only grows where something sacred is buried.

questions.prompt: What is an authenticator app commonly used to generate?
questions.fact: It generates a code from a shared secret and the current time, which is why the code changes every 30 seconds and works with no signal at all.
